name: Ember: A First Flame
description: A thin primer, soot-edged and well thumbed. The first lesson is how to light a candle without being in the room.
notes: The tome that teaches the Ember spell (mw-e08.2), the book half of the fire chain's first step (ADR-0004: Ember, Firebolt, Flame Jet, Fire Wall). Item id equals the spell id so the cover art id is ui-book-cover-ember (bookCoverArtId); every E08 spell's teaching book follows that pattern. Licensed fire magic, common: the Lamplit Stacks stock it. Study time is 20 minutes; the scroll of the same spell is scroll-of-ember. Base value 120 sits with a first-step spell book in the economy tome band.
